national_news.title: India Reiterate Stance on J&K and Terrorism at United Nations
bullets: India exercised its Right of Reply in the Fourth Committee of the UN General Assembly, slamming Pakistan and asserting that Jammu and Kashmir is and will always remain an integral part of India.
At the UN First Committee meeting, India warned that it will not be deterred by nuclear threats and maintains a zero-tolerance approach to state-sponsored terrorism.
India highlighted the deployment of countermeasures like Operation Sindoor and urged caution regarding nuclear proliferation networks like that of Abdul Qadeer Khan.

national_news.title: CAQM Reviews Stubble Burning Prevention Measures in Punjab
bullets: A high-level team of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) reviewed stubble burning prevention measures in the Amritsar and Tarn Taran districts of Punjab.
The review focused on effective in-situ and ex-situ utilization of paddy straw and the timely availability of Crop Residue Management (CRM) machinery.
Control rooms, help desks, and baler operations have been set up to establish supply chains with industries having boilers for paddy straw management.

national_news.title: Transformation of Indian Lighthouses into Tourism and Modern Navigational Hubs
bullets: India has over 11,000 km of coastline and 205 lighthouses, with 75 lighthouses developed as prominent tourism destinations featuring museums, pathways, and gardens.
Lighthouse tourism witnessed a significant rise from 4 lakh visitors in 2014 to 18.63 lakh visitors in 2024-25.
All Indian lighthouses are now solar-powered, and 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations have been installed under the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL).

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Team India for WorldSkills Competition 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with Team India representatives for the WorldSkills Competition, Shanghai 2026 in New Delhi.
Team India secured the 10th position at the 48th WorldSkills Competition held from 22 to 27 September 2026, winning 6 Silver Medals and 20 Medals for Excellence.
India was represented by its largest-ever contingent of 70 competitors participating across 63 skills.

national_news.title: PM Mementos e-Auction Features 18 Items from Andhra Pradesh
bullets: 18 mementos from Andhra Pradesh, including Kondapalli Woodcraft and Kalamkari art, were included in the PM Mementos collection for public e-auction.
The collection features traditional crafts, cultural items, and contemporary awards like the Stree Shakti Pratibha Award-2025 Commemorative Memento.
Proceeds from the PM Mementos e-Auction are directed towards the Namami Gange programme for the conservation of River Ganga.

national_news.title: Digital Trust and ABHA IDs Milestone in Indian Healthcare
bullets: As of 17 September 2026, India recorded 97.61 crore ABHA IDs in operation with 119.95 crore health records linked to them.
Over 50 crore teleconsultations have been conducted, including through the government's e-Sanjeevani service.
The article highlights the critical need for robust digital trust and continuous identity verification across the patient journey under digital healthcare initiatives.

national_news.title: INS Kulish Visits Singapore for Operational Turnaround under Eastern Fleet Deployment
bullets: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Kulish arrived at Tuas Terminal in Singapore for operational turnaround (OTR) as part of the Indian Navy's Eastern Fleet Operational Deployment.
The visit aligns with India's Act East Policy, MAHASAGAR vision, and efforts to strengthen bilateral maritime engagement and regional cooperation.

INS Kulish and INS Sahyadri recently participated in the 23rd ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus) Experts' Working Group on Maritime Security Joint Cooperative Activity at Subic Bay, Philippines.

bihar_news.title: Prabhat Kumar Sinha Appointed Chairman of ICC Bihar State Council
bullets: The Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) appointed Prabhat Kumar Sinha as the new Chairman of its Bihar State Council.
The announcement was made by ICC President Parthiv Neotia during the Chamber's Annual General Meeting held in Kolkata.
The appointment aims to boost industrial growth, attract private investments, strengthen MSMEs and startups, and enhance industry-government collaboration in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Upholds Promotees' Seniority and Gradation List in Bihar Police Service
bullets: The Supreme Court upheld the validity of the gradation list and the seniority of promotee officers in the Bihar Police Service based on continuous officiation.
The court clarified that Rule 3 of the Bihar Police Service (Recruitment) Rules does not impose a fixed quota and permits filling more than half of the vacancies with promotees.
The judgment set aside the Patna High Court's earlier ruling and dismissed the related writ petitions challenging the State's executive power to regulate public services.

bihar_news.title: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi Highlights NEP 2020 at Student Event in Bihar
bullets: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi stated that education must go beyond rote learning and securing jobs, focusing instead on innovation for a developed India by 2047.
He addressed an event in Bihar felicitating winners of the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' painting and speech competitions.
The initiative witnessed participation from students across 95,195 government and private schools spanning all 38 districts of Bihar.

bihar_news.title: ICC Bihar State Council Focuses on Accelerating State Industrial Growth
bullets: Newly appointed ICC Bihar State Council Chairman Prabhat Kumar Sinha prioritized facilitating investments and strengthening MSMEs and startups in Bihar.
The council aims to act as a bridge between policymakers and industry representatives to improve the ease of doing business and technology adoption.
The initiative aligns with Bihar's broader economic transformation goals to expand manufacturing capabilities and generate employment opportunities.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Bullet Train Project: Patna Selected Among 5 Proposed Stations
bullets: Bihar is included in the Varanasi-Patna-Siliguri high-speed rail corridor announced in Union Budget 2026-27.
Five districts identified for bullet train stations are Patna, Buxar, Begusarai, Khagaria, and Katihar.
The project will leverage Japanese Shinkansen high-speed rail technology.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans ₹1.88 Lakh Crore Energy Investment
bullets: Bihar proposed ₹1,88,383 crore in energy-sector investments covering generation, transmission, distribution, and renewable energy.
The state targets 24 GW of renewable energy and 6.1 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2029-30.
Proposals include a 2,800 MW nuclear power project in Banka and 8,400 MW of pumped storage across four districts.

bihar_news.title: Bihar MSME Policy 2026 Launched to Make Families Self-Reliant
bullets: Bihar launched the MSME Policy 2026 with a target to make one crore families self-reliant through entrepreneurship.
The government plans to develop 45,000 entrepreneurs with an outlay of ₹3,500 crore.
Bihar aims to attract ₹5 lakh crore in industrial investments and provide 20,000 MW of power to industries over five years.

bihar_news.title: Patna High Court Directs Reconsideration of Pay Protection and Pension for Long-Serving Employee
bullets: The Patna High Court directed Bihar's Water Resources Department to reconsider the service, pay protection, and pensionary claims of a daily-wage employee who worked continuously since 1980.
The petitioner was regularized as a Lower Division Clerk in 2012, but his absorption was treated as a fresh appointment, reducing his basic pay from Rs. 9,840 to Rs. 7,730.
The Court instructed the competent authority to examine the claims under Rule 78 of the Bihar Service Code and the Bihar Pension Rules, 1950, within three months.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Directs Officials to Expedite 'Seva Sankalp, Kayakalp' Campaign
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister directed departments to expedite the 'Seva Sankalp and Kayakalp Abhiyan' to ensure time-bound completion of public infrastructure projects without compromising quality.
The campaign focuses on improving basic facilities in schools, healthcare institutions (primary and sub-divisional health centers), Anganwadi centers, and public utilities.
Key directives included ensuring clean drinking water, electricity, and boundary walls in schools, along with the repair of streetlights, tubewells, and bus stand beautification.
